fusions.name: Fetlock Nip
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: a kick at its heels that deals 8 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Herding Circle
fusions.desc: You circle the pack, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Bay Them In
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A hound fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Carriage Hound
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded hound that runs at your heels and strikes enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
